verdict.rationale: Missive documents AI drafting: you can compose and reply with AI inside Missive (missive-docs-49), and the assistant, rules, and MCP clients like Claude create drafts you review before sending (missive-docs-50, missive-docs-21). None of the evidence covers matching the user's own voice or tone, such as learning from sent mail or style settings; the only personalization shown is signature-style {{ user.name }} and {{ user.email }} variables. missing for 10: voice/tone learning or style customization of AI drafts, evidence that drafts avoid generic boilerplate, independent or hands-on corroboration of draft quality.
